name: Huron County, OH
findings: Huron County has 212 nonprofit organizations. 80 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 58 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Huron County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 14 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 7 social and fraternal organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 3 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do social and fraternal organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Huron County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
